result.instructions: Tools for Resend, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my sent emails bounced or failed in the last week?"; "Are my sending domains verified, and which DNS records are still missing?"; "Schedule a plain-text reminder email for tomorrow at 09:00 UTC.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Resend data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run resend_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run resend_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run resend_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. resend_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: resend_list_emails
tools.title: List sent emails
tools.description: List emails sent through the account, newest first, with recipients, subject, and last event (delivered, bounced, etc.). Resend API: GET /emails.

after.description: Return items after this id (the last id of the previous page).

tools.name: resend_get_email
tools.title: Get a sent email
tools.description: Get one sent email by id: sender, recipients, subject, body, timestamps and last event. Resend API: GET /emails/{id}.

email_id.description: The email id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: resend_send_email
tools.title: Send an email
tools.description: Send one email from a verified domain, now or at scheduled_at. It reaches real recipients: confirm the content first. Pass idempotency_key on every attempt so a retry cannot send twice. Resend API: POST /emails.

from.description: Sender, e.g. "Team <team@yourdomain.com>". The domain must be verified.

to.description: One address, or an array of up to 50 addresses.

html.description: HTML body. Give html, text, or both.

text.description: Plain-text body. Give html, text, or both.

cc.description: One address, or an array of up to 50 addresses.

bcc.description: One address, or an array of up to 50 addresses.

reply_to.description: One address, or an array of up to 50 addresses.

scheduled_at.description: Send later: an ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z.

topic_id.description: Topic id: contacts who opted out of the topic get no mail.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this send. The same key is sent only once (Idempotency-Key header).

tools.name: resend_cancel_scheduled_email
tools.title: Cancel a scheduled email
tools.description: Cancel an email that was scheduled with scheduled_at and not sent yet. Sent mail cannot be cancelled. Resend API: POST /emails/{id}/cancel.

email_id.description: The scheduled email id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: resend_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Add a contact by email, with optional name, custom properties and unsubscribed flag. Resend API: POST /contacts.

unsubscribed.description: true = the contact gets no broadcast mail.

properties.description: Custom contact properties: text, number, or true/false values.
